title: Frontend Slides
description: A controlled three-pair evaluation of the pinned Frontend Slides skill on a complete, pre-approved seven-slide investor-deck brief.
method: Three blind baseline-versus-skill pairs in isolated Harbor containers. Same model, prompt, files, and objective checker; only the skill installation changed.
claim: On this fixed-stage deck task, the skill won two blind pairs and tied one; its outputs passed every objective check, versus one of three baselines.
status_explanation: The result supports this exact deck-building task, not a universal presentation-quality claim.
limitations: One task family with three paired samples.
The brief supplied an already-approved visual direction; the interactive style-selection phase was not evaluated.
Visual quality was judged from recorded artifacts, not audience outcomes.

title: Taste Skill
description: A controlled three-pair evaluation of the pinned Taste Skill on a technical B2B landing-page redesign.
method: Three blind baseline-versus-skill pairs in isolated Harbor containers. Same model, prompt, source page, and objective checker; only the skill installation changed.
claim: On this landing-page redesign, the skill won all three blind pairs and passed all three objective checks; no baseline did.
status_explanation: The result supports this exact marketing-page redesign task, not dashboards or every frontend category.
limitations: One task family with three paired samples.
The skill explicitly excludes dashboards; this evaluation stays within its landing-page scope.
No production conversion or user study was measured.

title: Remotion Create
description: A controlled three-pair evaluation of Remotion's pinned official creation skill on a deterministic ten-second launch-video composition.
method: Three blind baseline-versus-skill pairs in isolated Harbor containers. Same model, prompt, video brief, and objective checker; only the official skill installation changed.
claim: On this Remotion composition task, the skill won two blind pairs and tied one; all skill outputs passed the deterministic-project checks, versus one baseline.
status_explanation: The result supports the measured project-authoring task; no video was rendered and perceptual playback quality was not measured.
limitations: One task family with three paired samples.
Static project correctness was checked; rendering was intentionally out of scope.
Remotion's upstream licence applies; Edge links to the official package rather than republishing it.
